minutes_text:
CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  May 25, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Rick Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 16 West Main Street
Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the
Chinese characters on the primary sign shall be fabricated consistently.

The applicant Anson Chan was present and he had no questions on the staff report.
Chiu concurred with staff comments. Regarding the circular pendant sign she questioned why the
name was upside down. The applicant stated that the logo has been established and trademarked.

Hernandez and Chiu requested clarification regarding staff comments. The face of the Chinese
character signage on the front elevation are cloud styled acrylic. The top two are consistent but the
third is cut away and will appear different. Hernandez and Udani concurred with staff comments
after the clarification.

There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

MOTION:
 •  Moved to approve the application with the condition that the third Chinese character shall
  be modified consistent with the other two characters.
 •  Moved by Hernandez. Seconded by Chiu.
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 3-0

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez

  1
 Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: 347 East Main Street
Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant Ryan Ybarra was present for Item number 2 and the staff report was given.

Chiu stated that the scale and design were acceptable.
Hernandez questioned the size hierarchy of the front vs the side signage and suggested altering the
proportions of the signs or spaces in the signs. This was discussed and was not possible within the
brand standards.

There were no public comments.
There were no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

Chiu moved to approve the application as submitted.
Hernandez seconded the motion.

The motion was approved unanimously.

MOTION:
 •  Moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  Moved by Chiu. Seconded by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 3-0

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 3:
APPLICANT: 2415 Whitney Drive
Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval with the following
condition: The applicant shall work with staff to address all Design Review Board concerns, and
should consensus between the staff and applicant not be reached, the applicant shall return to the
DRB under the same application.

The applicant King Choi was present for Item number 3 and the staff report was given.

The applicant had 4 questions for the Board and the City Staff:
- Can the DRB approve a variance to avoid the 6 ’side yard setback and allow for a 2-story wall
  along the property line?
- The owner wants to change the style, can it be approved tonight and then changed later?
- Is the ADU under the purview of the DRB?

  2
 - Can the owner occupy the ADU during the remodel construction?

Staff answered the 4 questions.
- A 2 story wall along the side yard that does not respect the code setback is possible but needs
  to be achieved through a modification or a variance. The applicant was directed to the Planning
  Department for that entitlement option.
- The approval by the DRB is for the submitted design. If the applicant wants to change the design
  it is suggested that he be continued and return with the final design.
- An ADU is not under the purview of the DRB
- Assuming that the ADU is built first the owner can theoretically live in the ADU during the
  house remodel.

The Board gave opinions on the general massing and the lack of detail in the documentation. The
extruded two story mass was discouraged and the drawings in scale and notation were deficient.

Hernandez moved to continue the item, Chiu seconds and the motion is approved unanimously.

MOTION:
 •  Moved to continue Item 3.
 •  Moved by Hernandez. Seconded by Chiu.
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 3-0

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 4:
APPLICANT: 2033 South 3rd Street
Recommended Action: CONTINUANCE - Recommendation is for continuance to allow the
applicant to redesign the proposal with a material and configuration more consistent with the style
of the home.

The applicant Johnson Chow was present for Item number 4 and the staff report was given.

He stated that his project is simple and it complied with code.

Chiu stated that she appreciated that the fence is code compliant but the color of the block should
be more consistent with the home. Her suggestion was grey. Regarding the wrought iron element,
a different pattern or style should be considered.

Hernandez concurred that the color could be improved. She explained that the goal of the DRB is
to help the aesthetics of the proposal. Since there is a driveway gate the expanse of the iron work
is more visible and important.

  3
 Udani concurred with the other comments and stated that the color should match the residence
architecture.

Abe suggested that a split face dark grey block be used in lieu of the peach colored precision block
and the Board and applicant concurred.

MOTION:
 •  Moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1) Dark Grey split face block will be used instead of the proposed block material
  2) The applicant shall work with staff on the final design of the wrought iron
 •  Moved by Chiu. Seconded by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 3-0

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:
• There were none.

ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Moved to adjourn.
 •  Moved by Hernandez. Seconded by Chiu.
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Roll Call Vote: 3-0

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
